item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy weekend! A whole day to play. It's Saturday, November 7. Time for the weather! It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Today in Shanghai, it will be covered in clouds. Temperatures will go up to 19 degrees, with a low of 15. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. Rain is about 12 percent likely today. The sun goes down at 5:00 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be wet and rainy, with a high of 19 degrees. Here's a question: what is the best thing about today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
